$comment: How npm run art recolours her painting to sit in the site's palette (plum, ink, lavender paper). Each pixel's brightness (0 dark to 1 light) picks a colour from these stops; keepColour adds back that much of her own hue on top (it keeps her cool dress shadows apart from the warm background); then the result is mixed over her colours by 'strength'. Set strength to 0 to ship her colours exactly as she painted them. Her file in art-src is never changed, and the X-ray is always made from her original.
